programs.title: Diesel Brothers: Race Against the Machine
programs.desc: Heavy D, Diesel Dave and the Dieselsellerz crew scramble to finish an F100 race truck in time to race the legendary Mint 400  Heavy D has the biggest giveaway yet: the Mighty Megaram.

programs.title: Car Fix
programs.desc: Jared relocates the gas tank of a 1966 Ford F100 from the cab to under the bed  Lou works under the hood and checks the breaks.
